representation: A vertical five-slot call stack labeled f(4) down to f(0); frames appear on the way down and disappear on the way back, with return values written into the surviving frames.
motion: A frame appears below the current top on each call, the top marker moves down; on each return the bottom frame disappears and the new top frame's label records its return value.
controls: state timeline with pause/continue checkpoints; no numeric slider
checkpoints: base case f(0) is reached last in the descent
misconceptionTest: The frames are pushed one at a time and only one top frame is active; the status says callers wait. The base case appears after all four recursive calls, not first. Pop order is f(0), f(1), f(2), f(3), f(4).
accessibility: Alt text; keyboard play/pause and checkpoints; each frame is labeled with its call and return value in text, and LIFO order is written in the note.
